_comment: OpenClaw automations for PandaBase. OpenClaw stores jobs in its SQLite state DB, so this file is documentation + input for `make install-agent-cron` (M8): each agent entry becomes `openclaw automations add --name <name> --cron <cron> --tz <tz> --session isolated --message 'Read the skill file <repo>/agent/skills/<skill>/SKILL.md first and follow it. <message>' --tools exec,read,write,message,browser --no-deliver`. Skills post to Discord themselves with the message tool, so run output isn't announced. Entries with `command` are command payloads (no model call) announced to the named channel instead. Times are household-local (tz). The Friday nudge and the Saturday build are command payloads (live 2026-11-06/07: the local model, given only "Use $grocery-cycle", never opened the skill and posted a made-up cart); the model only runs the steps that need judgment.

jobs.name: pandabase-friday-nudge
jobs._comment: Command payload: records the nudge and prints the check-in (NO_REPLY when already nudged).

jobs.name: pandabase-saturday-build
jobs._comment: Command payload: tier 1 + price checks, then prints what was added and what is left for the 10:30 search. Silent while it works, hence the timeout.

jobs.name: pandabase-saturday-search
jobs.message: Do only the Saturday tier-2 search (§4, Tier 2). First run `pandabase-tools cart pending`. If its status is nothing_pending, reply exactly NO_REPLY. Never run `cart build`.

jobs.name: pandabase-monday-open
jobs.message: Do §1 only: make sure a cycle is open (Monday fallback).

jobs.name: pandabase-job-replies
jobs._comment: Command payload: no model turn. `openclaw automations add --name pandabase-job-replies --cron '*/5 * * * *' --tz America/Los_Angeles --command 'pandabase-tools jobs replies' --command-env PANDABASE_CONFIG=... --announce --channel discord --to channel:<intake_channel>`. Prints NO_REPLY when there is nothing to say.

jobs.name: pandabase-cart-probe
jobs._comment: Command payload: no model turn. Opens one Amazon and one Whole Foods product page (cart.probe_asins) and checks the add button is still found, without clicking. Prints NO_REPLY when both are fine, else one ⚠️ line for the ops channel.

jobs.name: pandabase-data-check
jobs._comment: Command payload: no model turn. Reads last week's data checks (one-store weeks, ad-like items, planned items that ran out long ago) and posts to the ops channel only when one is flagged; NO_REPLY otherwise.
